item.title: Easily Deploy Umami for Website Traffic Statistics on Vercel
item.description: Umami is a simple, fast, and privacy-focused open-source website statistics tool, making it an ideal alternative to Google Analytics. This article will guide you on how to deploy Umami on Vercel and create a Neon PostgreSQL database via Vercel Storage, to build a zero-cost, lightweight website traffic statistics system. This tutorial is specifically optimized for Hugo static site users, ensuring that the generated Markdown files are compatible with Hugo’s static site generation.
